name: Privatzimmer Praschberger
beschreibung: The Gasthof Praschberger is located in Kufstein, the festival city of Tirol. The house is conveniently located near the city center and offers a quiet retreat for visitors. Guests can expect personally managed private rooms with traditional charm and a cozy guest lounge. The cuisine offers regional specialties. The inn is suitable for travelers seeking hospitality of Tirol in a relaxed atmosphere.
